newsitem.title: USA: CSX Transportation speeds up S.C. trains.
newsitem.headline: CSX Transportation speeds up S.C. trains.

text.p: CSX Corp unit CSX Transportation Inc said it would increase the speed of its trains operating through the South Carolina towns of Swansea, Woodford, North Livingston, Neeses and Norway, effective May 7.
The speed increase would be phased in over a three week period in accordance with Federal Reserve Administration regulation, the company said.

The company said over the past year its engineering teams had made improvements to the track structure and changes to the highway-rail grade crossing devices in order to permit the trains to travel faster.
